jobs.title: Support Engineer, U.S. Government Support (SHIFT)
jobs.description_text: An overview of this role This is an overnight shift role with working hours of 12:00am - 7:00am EST. As a Support Engineer on our U.S. Government Support Engineering team, you operate at the critical intersection of Support and Engineering, enabling public sector organizations and United States government agencies to run GitLab in some of the most secure and constrained environments in the world. Your work directly supports national security missions, including customers operating within FedRAMP-authorized, air-gapped, and classified or semi-classified environments where traditional troubleshooting approaches are not always possible. In this role, you will engage deeply with GitLab through the command line; analyzing logs, system behavior, and application performance with strong Linux fundamentals and an understanding of how GitLab’s components interact end-to-end. You may partner with Product and Engineering to reproduce and document edge-case defects using sanitized or redacted data, or contribute directly to the product by opening merge requests that resolve customer-impacting issues. Beyond resolving individual cases, you’ll help strengthen GitLab by improving documentation, support workflows, and institutional knowledge, ensuring that lessons learned in highly regulated environments benefit the broader platform; all while working in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment built on trust, autonomy, and shared ownership. jobs.title: QA Specialist
jobs.description_text: QA Specialist HumanSignal is looking for QA Specialists to support an audio and video data processing project. You'll work with recorded media files, align audio and video, trim recordings, and perform quality checks using our Label Studio platform and established processing guidelines. This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role that could be a great fit for individuals with experience in data annotation, media editing, quality assurance, or anyone who is tech-savvy, organized, and comfortable working with digital tools. What you’ll do Retrieve and organize audio and video recordings from designated storage locations and import them into Label Studio. Synchronize multiple audio and video recordings, aligning footage and audio waveforms to the correct timestamps according to project guidelines. Trim recordings to the required start and end points, ensuring all relevant content is retained. Follow established playbooks for media alignment, trimming, file naming, export settings, and file size requirements. Perform quality checks to identify missing files, synchronization errors, incomplete recordings, or other inconsistencies. Save, export, and organize completed files according to the required formats and submission procedures. Troubleshoot basic processing or platform issues, proactively flagging problems and escalating concerns when needed. jobs.title: Field Sales Account Manager
jobs.description_text: Team Overview: Join a small but seasoned team of sales account managers responsible for selling our EPIC tag ICs into a global ecosystem of UHF RFID inlay bonders, service bureaus and end-users. The specific focus for this position will be ecosystem partners in the larger Americas territory. jobs.description_text: Scope of the Role: We are recruiting US-based architects, Civil Engineers and certified plans examiners to evaluate the output of an AI system that performs automated building-code compliance review on architectural permit applications. The system ingests permit submissions — new builds, alterations, modifications — and issues a compliant or non-compliant determination for each applicable check, drawn from the International Building Code. Every determination comes with a cited code provision and a marked location on the drawing set showing the evidence relied upon. Your job is to tell us where the system got it wrong. You are applying the same judgment you already apply in plan review or permit preparation, to a set of determinations that have already been made. Where the system is correct, you confirm it. Where it is wrong, you correct it and the correction becomes training signal. This is expert review work, not data entry. There is no volume of repetitive clicking to grind through and no generalist labeling pool to compete with — the entire premise of the program is that these judgments cannot be made by anyone without real code expertise. What You’ll Own: Review and correct pass/fail verdicts, written rationales, and citation boxes on PDF plans using the in-tool editing toolkit. This is the applied-expert counterpart to our Speech & Audio Research Scientist. You set the standards the models are trained and measured against, and you understand the big picture: how different transcription and segmentation methods change what a model learns, and how that ripples into the speech and content-understanding systems our partners are building. You know the research and you know the tools — from IPA and acoustic analysis to forced alignment and the ASR engines our partners benchmark against — but your leverage is linguistic judgment and standard-setting at scale, not building models yourself. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Robotics & World Models
jobs.description_text: Scope of the Role: Progress in physical AI is gated as much by data design as by model architecture. The best manipulation and locomotion policies, vision-language-action models, and world models are only as good as the trajectories, demonstrations, and environments they learn from — so the highest-leverage decisions are made long before a model trains: what to capture, what to synthesize, how to represent an action, and how to know whether any of it will transfer to a real robot. Innodata is building the data and evaluation practice behind the next generation of robotics foundation models, in direct partnership with the customers and frontier labs defining that frontier. We are hiring a Research Scientist to own the science of that data. You will partner directly with the customers and frontier labs building robot foundation models, as interested in the data those models learn from as in the models themselves. Your leverage is scientific judgment about data: deciding what is worth capturing in the real world versus generating in simulation, how to weight a training mix across embodiments and sensors, and how to measure whether a policy will hold up outside the lab. Your conclusions will shape what our partners collect next. What You’ll Own: You will define how Innodata designs, structures, and evaluates data for robot foundation models, and you will validate those choices experimentally. Concretely, you will: Translate the requirements of robotics foundation models — vision-

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Speech & Audio
jobs.description_text: Scope of the Role: Where models actually differ now is robustness across accents, noise, and code-switching; speaker diarization; the naturalness of generated speech; and latency under streaming. Measuring those honestly, and building the data that trains for them, is gated as much by data and evaluation design as by architecture. Innodata builds that data and those evaluations for the customers and frontier labs advancing speech and audio models, and we are hiring a Research Scientist to own the science behind it. You will partner directly with the customers and frontier labs building ASR, text-to-speech, speech-to-speech and conversational voice, diarization, and audio-language models, as interested in the data behind them as in the models themselves. Your work is judgment: which conditions and languages a benchmark must cover to be honest, what a transcription convention should be for a given objective, and when an automated metric can be trusted versus when a human ear is required. You will also partner closely with our transcription and linguistics lead, whose standards directly shape what the models learn. What You’ll Own: You will define how Innodata designs, structures, and evaluates audio data for speech and audio models, and you will validate those choices experimentally. Concretely, you will: Translate the requirements of speech and audio models — ASR, text-to-speech and speech generation, speech-to-speech and conversational voice, speaker diarization and verificat

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Video & Multimodal
jobs.description_text: Scope of the Role: Video is where multimodal models are weakest and hardest to grade. Temporal reasoning, long-form understanding, grounding events in time, and holding audio, video, and text together do not fall out of image benchmarks — and the evaluations for them are still immature. Closing that gap is gated as much by how we design data and evaluation as by architecture. Innodata builds that data and those evaluations for the customers and frontier labs advancing video and multimodal models, and we are hiring a Research Scientist to own the science behind it. You will partner directly with the customers and frontier labs building video understanding, video-language, and video-generation models, as interested in the data behind them as in the models themselves. Video spans two model families judged in completely different ways: models that understand video — answering questions, localizing events, grounding language in time — where the question is whether the answer is correct; and models that generate it, where fidelity, temporal coherence, and physical plausibility matter and no automatic metric is settled. You own the evaluation science for both, and knowing when model-based scoring can stand in for a human versus when it can't. Your conclusions shape what our partners measure and collect next. What You’ll Own: You will define how Innodata designs, structures, and evaluates video data for video and multimodal models, and you will validate those choices experimentally.

jobs.title: Intern, FFBA Analytical Development
jobs.description_text: Legend Biotech is seeking an Intern, FFBA Analytical Development as part of the Technical Development team based in Somerset, NJ. Role Overview We are seeking an enthusiastic and driven Intern to join Functional, Flow Cytometry and BioAnalytics team within our empowered Analytical Development organization. The intern will focus on supporting the development of novel flow cytometry-based methods to assess cellular metabolism in immune and engineered cell products. The project will focus on establishing robust essays to characterize metabolic states of t cells transduced with LB2501 LVV. Working closely with principal scientists in Analytical Development, the candidate will design experiments, optimize staining panels, analyze multiparametric flow cytometry data, and documentation. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with scientists to identify pain points in the electronic sample ascension process. Develop and draft procedures to streamline and organize sample data and test reporting. Observe and assist with routine testing of non-critical samples. Perform routine laboratory activities, like equipment calibration, cleaning, and general laboratory upkeep. Assist in the creation of accurate Electronic Laboratory Notebook entries and LIMS sample templates. This is a closely mentored role, and most decisions about planning and execution will require collaboration,consensus and alignment with senior scientists. Requirements Undergraduate or master’s student in: Immunology Cell Biology

jobs.description_text: Legend Biotech is seeking a Principal Scientist, Bioinformatics as part of the Research & Development team based in Somerset, NJ.
